1479-2841-2922-8337.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Obscura Storefront.
1479-2841-2922-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Obscura Storefront.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3099-3360-6723.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3360-6723.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

728-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
728-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1563-2457-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

225-4094-4772-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1895-4399-4506-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4506-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1090-1594-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2107-4091-7791.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Sunastian Falconer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.

1251-1368-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1251-1368-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-1123-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
997-1123-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

2103-5913-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2239-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Ardent Elementalist and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
2239-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

1765-5147-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-5147-5972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1669-3215-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-5147-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-5147-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-4053-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
3967-4053-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4336-5220-5683-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2816-3918-4851.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

394-413-1445-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-413-1445-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

277-880-5671.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-5671.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

64-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Warden of the Eye
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Warden of the Eye
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-5231-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-5231-5434.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {R}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {R}.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Repeat.

2034-2483-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Syndicate Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
When Syndicate Messenger dies, its afterlife ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Syndicate Messenger trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Syndicate Messenger from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

880-3678-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

411-3593-5112.notablePrerequisites:
Grinning Ignus exiled with a cage counter on it.
Any artifact or creature that can produce red mana exiled with a cage counter on it.
411-3593-5112.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Mairsil onto the battlefield.
Activate Mairsil using artifact or creature that can produce {R} by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Mairsil using Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

1329-1414-3152.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lotus Petal by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
